description: Black to kill. White has the shape of an L with one extra eye-stone. Find the throw-in that destroys both potential eyes, then follow up to capture.

B9.comment: Vital point. The throw-in attacks both potential eyes (A9 and C9) at once.

E9.comment: Remove white's last outside liberty. White is forced to capture, but the resulting shape has only one eye.

B9.comment: Throw in again. White has only one eye and no outside liberties - the whole group is captured.

A9.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with B9 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at A9 and C9.

C9.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with B9 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at A9 and C9.

E9.comment: Outside before inside fails - white plays the vital point B9 and lives with two clean eyes.
